plot.p2: Natural light and heat protection guide where openings, light wells and shading fins go.

process.h2: Know each step before you start
process.lead: Ten working steps, grouped into four stages.
process.s1: You send the location, building type and timing. The first conversation is free.
process.s2: ECO ARCH surveys the existing home, quotes by design area, and both sides sign the contract.
process.s3: Reading sun and wind, drawing options, explaining each choice and completing the documents for your package.
process.s4: Documents are handed over and accepted. Silence is never treated as acceptance.

scope.h2: Know which documents you receive, and where our scope ends
scope.lead: ECO ARCH is a design consultancy. Scope and documents are stated clearly before you sign.
scope.get1: A survey record of the existing home
scope.get2: A table explaining why each option was chosen
scope.get3: A list of documents for the package you choose
scope.limit2: Construction, materials and furniture are quoted separately.
scope.limit3: Changes during the work are handled under the contract.

faq.a1: ECO ARCH is a design consultancy for architecture, interiors and home renovation in Hanoi, in three packages: 2D preliminary design, 3D concept design, and complete architecture and interior design.
faq.a2: No. ECO ARCH advises and designs only. Construction, materials and furniture are quoted separately.
faq.a3: The design fee is per m² of the design area stated in the contract: Package 1 is 100.000 đ/m², Package 2 is 220.000 đ/m², Package 3 is 340.000 đ/m². The first consultation is free. Construction, materials and furniture are quoted separately.
faq.q4: How soon will I hear back?
faq.a4: After you send a booking request, ECO ARCH replies within 24 hours to arrange a call.
faq.q5: What should I prepare before the first call?
faq.a5: The plot location, building type, when you want to start, and a few photos of the existing home if you have them. You do not need drawings yet.
